# Shivam Thakur — Full Stack Developer

> applications end to end with React, Next.js and Node.js. This site is his portfolio:
> case studies of shipped products, the services he offers, and practical articles on
> modern web development. The whole site is static HTML with clean, extensionless URLs.

## Case Studies

- [Case Studies overview](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies): index of selected projects with problem, solution and results.
- [MyDigiSense](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/mydigisense-digital-presence-marketplace-platform): a SaaS platform for digital presence and a services marketplace — website, listings and bookings in one place. Built with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Live at https://mydigisence.com
- [ProDigiChat](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/prodigichat-whatsapp-marketing-automation-platform): a SaaS WhatsApp marketing and automation tool — broadcast campaigns, chatbot flows and a shared team inbox on the WhatsApp Cloud API. Built with React, Node.js, Redis and WebSockets. Live at https://prodigichat.com
- [DigiCRM](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/digicrm-invoice-payment-management-crm): a CRM portal for invoice and payment management — automated invoice generation and PDFs, scheduled email payment reminders, payment tracking and client management. Built with Next.js, Node.js and PostgreSQL.
- [MailMaster](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/mailmaster-bulk-email-marketing-platform): a bulk email marketing platform — campaigns at scale, contact list import and segmentation, reusable templates, suppression and bounce handling, and open and click tracking. Built with Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL and Redis.
- [IDMATS](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/idmats-digital-marketing-technical-skills-institute): the website for IDMATS, a digital marketing and technical skills institute — a dedicated indexable page per course with Course structured data, admission enquiry capture tagged to the course, and mobile-first performance tuned for local course searches. Live at https://idmats.in
- [DigiConn Unite](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/digiconn-unite-digital-marketing-agency-website): the website for DigiConn Unite, a digital marketing agency — a dedicated indexable page per service with Service structured data, lead capture wired into every page and tagged by service, and mobile performance tuned for Core Web Vitals. Live at https://digiconnunite.com
- [FlayerMarketing](https://shivamthakur.me/case-studies/flayermarketing-digital-marketing-agency-website): the website for FlayerMarketing, a digital marketing agency — campaign-led service pages with structured data, enquiry capture on every page tagged by service, and mobile-first performance built for ad traffic. Live at https://flayermarketing.com

## Services

- [Services overview](https://shivamthakur.me/services): the 8 services Shivam offers, each with scope, process, timelines and FAQ.
- [Full-Stack Web Apps](https://shivamthakur.me/services/web-development): Custom full-stack web apps built with React, Next.js and Node.js — database, API and fast UI, delivered end to end. Based in Agra, working worldwide.
- [SaaS Product Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/saas-product-development): SaaS development from idea to paying MVP: multi-tenant architecture, Stripe subscriptions, onboarding and admin dashboards. Built to launch fast and scale.
- [AI Integration & Agents](https://shivamthakur.me/services/ai-integration): AI integration services: RAG chatbots trained on your documents, AI features in your app and AI agents that automate work. Secure and cost-controlled.
- [Mobile App Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform mobile app development for iOS and Android from one codebase — native feel, push notifications, payments and App Store release.
- [APIs & Integrations](https://shivamthakur.me/services/api-integrations): API development and integration services — REST and GraphQL APIs, payment gateways, WhatsApp Business and Meta APIs, CRM sync and webhooks that just work.
- [Business Software (CRM, ERP & Dashboards)](https://shivamthakur.me/services/crm-erp-development): Custom CRM, ERP and dashboard development built around your process — sales pipelines, inventory, orders, finance and live reports in one secure system.
- [E-commerce Development](https://shivamthakur.me/services/ecommerce-development): E-commerce website development — fast storefronts, smooth checkout, Razorpay and Stripe payments, inventory and shipping. Shopify or fully custom stores.
- [Cloud, DevOps & Care](https://shivamthakur.me/services/cloud-devops-services): Cloud hosting, CI/CD, Core Web Vitals and technical SEO, uptime monitoring, backups and monthly website maintenance — fast, secure and always online.
